findings.issue_text: [High/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:194-200 — `enableSqlExpressions` always returns false: `enabled` is assigned the negation of `IsEnabledGlobally(FlagSqlExpressions)` and the fallthrough return is hardcoded `false`, making the flag a no-op so SQL expressions are rejected even when `FlagSqlExpressions` is enabled; the final return should be `true` (or `return h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...)`), or the dead flag check should be removed if hard-disabling is intended

[Medium/bug] pkg/expr/sql/db.go:10-22 — the new `DB` stub unconditionally returns "not implemented" from `TablesList`, `RunCommands`, and `QueryFramesInto`, making `Execute` (pkg/expr/sql_command.go:101) and `TablesList` (pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:23) guaranteed-failure paths; flag-enabled users will hit runtime errors on every SQL expression — either implement the engine or remove the flag/feature surface entirely

[Medium/test_gap] No test changes accompany the stubbing — existing tests exercising `TablesList`, `QueryFramesInto`, or SQL command execution (e.g., pkg/expr/sql/parser_test.go, pkg/expr/sql_command_test.go) will fail against the stubs, and there is no unit test for the new gate (flag on → query accepted, flag off → rejected) that would have caught the always-false bug

[Low/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:130 — the error "sqlExpressions is not implemented" conflates "feature flag disabled" with "feature not implemented", so operators who enable the flag get the same message and can't tell if they misconfigured it; it should report the actual condition and use the package's `errutil` bad-request pattern so clients get an appropriate status

[Low/api] pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16,20 — `RunCommands` and `QueryFramesInto` accept no `context.Context`, so once a real engine backs the stub, user-supplied SQL cannot be cancelled or time-bounded; adding `ctx` now avoids a breaking signature change when the implementation lands
[Low/doc_defect] PR title "Advanced SQL Analytics Framework" does not match the change, which removes the go-duck/DuckDB implementation and stubs SQL expressions behind an always-off gate
[Low/doc_defect] No changelog entry for the user-facing behavior change (SQL expressions now error even with the flag enabled)

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/test_gap] No test changes accompany the stubbing — existing tests exercising `TablesList`, `QueryFramesInto`, or SQL command execution (e.g., pkg/expr/sql/parser_test.go, pkg/expr/sql_command_test.go) will fail against the stubs, and there is no unit test for the new gate (flag on → query accepted, flag off → rejected) that would have caught the always-false bug

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces broken behavior: `enableSqlExpressions` in `pkg/expr/reader.go` returns `false` on every path (it sets `enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...)` and then returns `false` regardless), so `QueryTypeSQL` is always rejected with `sqlExpressions is not implemented`. Separately, SQL execution/parsing now uses a new in-repo `pkg/expr/sql` `DB` whose methods (`RunCommands`, `QueryFramesInto`, etc.) all return `not implemented`, and `TablesList` in `pkg/expr/sql/parser.go` now calls `NewInMemoryDB()` from that package, meaning `TablesList` will now always error. The finding’s point about missing tests is secondary, but the underlying failures are verifiable from the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:130 — the error "sqlExpressions is not implemented" conflates "feature flag disabled" with "feature not implemented", so operators who enable the flag get the same message and can't tell if they misconfigured it; it should report the actual condition and use the package's `errutil` bad-request pattern so clients get an appropriate status

adjudication.rationale: In `pkg/expr/reader.go` the SQL path gates on `enableSqlExpressions(h)` and returns `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")` when it is false. The new `enableSqlExpressions` implementation always returns `false` regardless of the flag value (`enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...)` then both branches return false), so SQL expressions are never enabled and callers always get the same "not implemented" error even if the feature flag is enabled. This both breaks intended behavior and produces a misleading error message conflating flag-disabled vs. implementation status; the suggested use of `errutil` is an API-quality improvement but the core issue is a real behavior bug shown by the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/api] pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16,20 — `RunCommands` and `QueryFramesInto` accept no `context.Context`, so once a real engine backs the stub, user-supplied SQL cannot be cancelled or time-bounded; adding `ctx` now avoids a breaking signature change when the implementation lands

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added stub engine `pkg/expr/sql/db.go`, methods like `RunCommands(commands []string)` and `QueryFramesInto(name, query string, frames []*data.Frame, f *data.Frame)` do not take a `context.Context`. The call site in `pkg/expr/sql_command.go` creates `db := sql.NewInMemoryDB()` and calls `db.QueryFramesInto(...)` without passing the existing `ctx` from `Execute(ctx, ...)`. This is a real API/design issue grounded in the diff: if a real SQL engine is later implemented behind these methods, adding cancellation/timeouts would require changing these public method signatures, so adding `ctx` now would avoid a future breaking change. It is not a current functional bug because the methods are stubbed and return `not implemented`.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does show removal of the go-duck dependency and replacement with a new stubbed `pkg/expr/sql` DB that returns "not implemented", plus an `enableSqlExpressions` gate that always returns false. However, the finding’s core claim is that the PR title ("Advanced SQL Analytics Framework") does not match the change; the PR title is not part of the provided diff, so this mismatch cannot be verified from the diff alone.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does introduce a behavior where SQL expressions always error (enableSqlExpressions always returns false in pkg/expr/reader.go, so QueryTypeSQL returns "sqlExpressions is not implemented" regardless of the flag). However, the finding specifically claims there is "No changelog entry" for this user-facing change, and the diff does not include or reference any changelog files, so the absence of an entry cannot be verified from the provided changes alone.
